entities.summary: The Bosuilstadion is an association football stadium in the city of Antwerp, Belgium. The stadium was opened in 1923 and has been the home of Royal Antwerp ever since. It has a capacity of 21,000, of which 800 are indoor VIP seats. It is located in the district of Deurne.
